summary.headline: Expedited quality update guidance uses a shorter section name
summary.summary: The quality update policy section is named Expedite Windows quality updates, keeping the same workflow in the consolidated policy guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Use this section when accelerating deployment of an urgent Windows quality update.

summary.headline: Quality update drill-down report clarifies Windows version grouping
summary.summary: The drill-down report description now refers to Windows feature versions and clarifies that Windows Insider or other releases are grouped when they do not match a generally available Windows feature release and documented quality-update level.
summary.adminImpact: Export the device list from the drill-down report to investigate devices outside the expected feature and quality update group.

summary.headline: Update Ring policy settings spacing normalized
summary.summary: The Update Ring policy settings content removes an extra blank separator.

summary.headline: Hybrid Entra quality update known issue withdrawn
summary.summary: The known issue for devices not receiving quality updates during Hybrid Entra joined deployments is removed, and the page date advances to January 13, 2026.
summary.adminImpact: Re-test quality update delivery in Hybrid Entra joined Autopilot scenarios rather than assuming the previous issue remains active.

summary.headline: Driver update requirements include cloud environment guidance
summary.summary: The driver update requirements now include the shared cloud prerequisite content.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm the tenant cloud environment is supported before creating driver update policies.
